Commentary.Commentary: Right! That's all from this game. The Kiwis have pocketed the series with one game still left. The third and final ODI between the two sides will be played on Friday, 26th March 2021. The action will begin at 1400 local (0100 GMT). We will look forward to your company once again. For now, it is goodbye from our side. Take care and cheers!

Tom Latham, the New Zealand skipper is back for the chat again. He tells that Bangladesh had wickets in hand but New Zealand controlled things nicely with the ball. Praises Santner for his bowling. Thinks they didn't get the best of the start but as the chase went on, they kept getting better. Says that it was a bit tricky surface and is pleased to cross the line. Talks highly of Conway and says that he has done superbly in domestic cricket and has got his best form in the international arena. Ends by saying that they want to improve more as a side.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, says that he felt that they could've won the game. Feels that their bowlers did really well to create chances but the fielders failed to support them. Adds that he is really disappointed with the result. Praises Rahim and Mithun for their batting. Adds that it was an improved performance from them but tells they are here to win the game as well. Reckons there will be dropped chances in the game of cricket but it hurts them. Says that people do not drop the catches willingly but they need to grab chances like these. Wants to be positive in the final ODI.

Tom Latham, the Kiwi skipper, is named Player of the Match for his superb knock. Starts by saying that it is really nice to have a match-winning contribution. Tells that it was all about partnerships during the chase. On facing the spinners, Latham says that the ball was turning a bit but the dew did make it a bit tough for them. Tells that they had their targets as a batting side and worked out their plans nicely.
Stay tuned for the presentation!

Earlier in the game, Latham won the toss and asked Bangladesh to bat first. On the back of a superb unbeaten 73 from Mithun and contributions from Tamim, Sarkar and Rahim, Bangladesh posted a fine total on the board. The Kiwis bowled tightly but failed to take wickets at regular intervals and that meant they gave away a few runs too many during the death overs. Santner was the pick of the bowlers with twin wickets. However, the likes of Boult, Henry and Jamieson too bowled tightly and got one wicket each to their name. Neesham had a poor game as he gave away 73 in his 9 overs. However, their good work in the first half with the ball meant that the Kiwis, led by their skipper's superb knock sealed the deal.

Chasing the total, the Kiwis didn't start well as Nicholls fell early and Guptill too didn't get going. Young departed in the 11th over of the game with the score reading just 53 for 3. However, after that, Conway along with skipper Latham added 100-plus to keep the Kiwis in the chase. Conway raked up his maiden ODI half ton before getting run out while trying to steal a single. Latham, however, continued and kept going. Bangladesh were really poor in the field as they put down a few chances. Latham and Neesham used the chances given and took the team close with their 76-run stand. Neesham holed out in search of quick runs but Latham continued and converted the half ton into a scintillating century to take the team home. Mitchell played his part by scoring 12 off 6.

Excellent run chase from the Kiwis and they have sealed the 3-match ODI series with a game to go. Just terrific from New Zealand and the skipper leading from the front, in front of his home crowd is extra special. Bangladesh had their chances with the ball but they just didn't pick it up. A number of dropped chances and sloppy fielding didn't help their cause one bit and they have been hammered again!
FOUR! There it is, there are the winning runs! A low full toss on the pads, Latham, the star for New Zealand, works it through square leg and it races away. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 5 WICKETS!

Confusion, a slip but all safe in the end!  On the pads, Latham looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. Mitchell wants a run and sets off. Latham is not interested. Mitchell slips as he looks to turn back to get in. The fielder though misses his shy at the bowler's end.
SCORES LEVEL! This is a length ball and on middle, Mitchell heaves it over the mid-wicket fielder. Does not time it right and hence, two.
FOUR! Just the three needed now! Shorter and on the body, Mitchell is not going to be troubled at that pace. He pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
What happened there? Mustafizur is hobbling off the ground. Seems to have done something to his leg. Soumya Sarkar will finish off his over.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! He loves hitting down the groud and that is what he does here! 9 more needed only. Fuller and around off, it is lofted over mid off for a boundary.

Does not carry! Once again luck favoring Latham! Shorter, Latham comes down the track and looks to pull but it takes the inside edge, then hits Latham's body and then lands short of the keeper who dives forward. 13 needed in 18.
FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! Everything going New Zealand's way! Short and outside off, Latham looks to pull but it goes off the top edge over the keeper's head and into the fence.
Mitchell shuffles right across and works this on the leg side for one.
Fumble again and an opportunity goes abegging again! On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! 100 for Latham! Take a bow the Kiwi skipper! What a knock. Walked out when New Zealand were in big, big trouble and now has taken his side right on top. What a shot to get to the ton. A short one on middle, Latham rolls his wrists over the ball, keeps it down and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. The helmet is off and the crowd is on its feet acknowledging the applause.
Taskin Ahmad to bowl out now. He has bowled really well but the luck hasn't been on his side.
Misifled and one! Fuller and on middle, Latham works it towards mid-wicket. The fielder lets it through and a single is taken.
FOUR! Up and over! The short ball ploy is just not working! It is well short and outside off, Latham guides it over point and he moves onto 95.
Just short and two! Shorter in length and outside off, Latham throws his bat at it. It goes towards deep point for two.
Daryl Mitchell, playing just his 2nd ODI, walks in next.

OUT! NEESHAM HOLES OUT! Bangladesh in it by just! Still 30 needed in 28. Rahman goes full this time and it works. It is a slower one. Neesham is early into the stroke and only manages to hit it high up in the air towards long on. The fielder, Sarkar, takes it comfortably.

FOUR! Crucial boundary! A short one, Neesham stands tall and pulls it from outside off. It is in the gap in the mid-wicket region. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone. Wided.
Fumble and a run! Fuller and on off, Latham hits it towards mid off. They go for one, the fielder did not pick it up cleanly.
Full and on middle, pushed down to long on for one. 10-1-42-2 from Mahedi.
Short and on the body, Neesham looks to pull but the ball takes the inner half and goes to fine leg. A run taken.
Tossed up and outisde off, lofted wide of long on for two more.
Flat and just around off, kept out.
FOUR! Nailed it. Neesham has nailed the reverse sweep. Floated full and on middle, Neesham got down and nailed the reverse sweep between short third man and backward point.
Floated outside off, Tom comes down the track and looks to go big over the off side. Mistimes it towards long on for one.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl out now. 9-1-33-2 from him so far.
Short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one more run. 45 needed in final 6.
Full and outside off, pushed on the off side for a run.
Banged short. Latham pulls it down to deep mid-wicket. One bounce towards the deep mid-wicket fielder.
Short and wide outside off, crunched to deep cover for one.
Play and a miss! Good length and outside off, Neesham looks to punch it on the off side but misses to connect.
Banged short and on middle, pulled down to long on for one. It was once again uppish but landed short.
Bowling change! Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
In the air... safe again. Floated full and on middle, Latham goes for the sweep but the ball hits the outer half and goes goes over  the keeper. A single to end.
Shortish and just outside off, Neesham strokes it to deep cover for one.
One more dot! Full and around off and middle, pushed to the man at covers. Excellent 4 balls from Mehidy so far.
Beaten! Flat and outside off, Neesham looks to force it on the off side but misses to connect.
Flat and around off, Neesham stays back to bunt it down.
Floated around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl out.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Very full ball around off, pushed on the off side for a quick run.

Confusion but safe! Shortish and just outside off, poked towards short third man. Neesham wants the single but Latham says no. James is a bit lazy to get back as the fielder scores a direct hit with his underarm throw. Neesham is in though.

Good stop near the fence. Taskin is the man. Short ball on middle and leg, Neesham is cramped for room but he manages to pull it wide of the man at fine leg. Taskin runs to his right and puts in a big effort to save two for his team.
Full ball on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball around middle, pushed to mid on for nothing.
Short and wide outside off, driven firmly down to deep cover. Single taken. They want the second but Latham slips.  5 off the over. 56 more needed in final 9.
Flat and around middle, kept out.
In the air... but over the man at mid on. Short and around off, Neesham pulls it. Mistimes it but clears the man at mid on who gives it a chase and pulls it back before the ropes. Three taken.
Short and wide outside off, slapped to deep cover for one by Latham.
One mroe dot. Floated outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Shortish and outside off, punched to the cover fielder.
Powerplay 3 time! Now, 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Good length and outside off, guided to third man for another run.
Fuller and outside off, flicked wide of the man at mid-wicket for one.
Banged short and on middle, it is pulled to fine leg for one.

Misfield and two. Sloppy from Bangladesh again. Mahmudullah is the man this time. Shortish and outside off, Tom punches it through backward point. Mahmudullah from deep point runs to his right but fails to pick up cleanly and allows one more.
Shortish and on middle, worked on the leg side for one more run.
Good length ball around middle, pushed down to long on for an easy run.
Loopy ball on middle, Latham looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes to square leg. A single sneaked.
Latham come down the track and looks to force it down to long on. Mistimes it to the left of the bowler and Mehidy stops.
Shortish and just outside off, Neesham punches it to long off and gets to the other end.
On off, blocked.
Flat and around off, punched wide of the man at backward point for a run.
Flat and outside off, punched down to long on for one.
Mehidy Hasan is back again.
Short and wide outside off, slpped to deep cover for one. 18 off the over.
He runs in and bangs it short again. Latham goes for the pull again. Finds fine leg on one bounce.

FOUR! Another one in the air, another one falls short and it is another misfield. This is some drama here. A short ball, Latham looks to take it on. He pulls it hard but not off the middle. The fielder at deep mid-wicket runs forward and tries to catch but it falls short. The fielder slips and looses the control on the ball and sees it go to the fence. 4 boundaries in the over. Taskin is livid with the effort.

EDGY FOUR! Latham is surely living dangerously here but he will take all these runs. A length ball outside off, Latham looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and races to the fine leg fence, going past his sticks.
FOUR! Up and over! Latham is living dangerously here. Full and wide outside off, he reaches out and hits it over the leaping backward point fielder. Trickles to the fence.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor from Tasking. Slips the length ball down the leg side. Latham looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pads and goes to the fine leg fence.
Dot to end the over. Full and around off, eased on the leg side.
Floated around off, kept out.
Uppish again but hit hard and hit wide. Full and outside off, Tom dances down again and hits it down to long off for one.

Put down! Another one has been put down. This could've been an even bigger scalp but Mahedi puts down one of the simplest chance he will ever going to get. Tossed up and outisde off, Latham dances down the track and chips it straight back to the bowler. Mahedi gets both hands but spills the chance.
Flat and just on middle, punched to the left side of the bowler. Mahedi makes a tumbling stop on that side.
Floated outside off, poked through the covers for a run.
Two to end the big over! Short and outside off, Tom slaps it wide of deep point and scampers back for two. 9 off the over. 92 more needed now in 84 balls.
FOUR! Pulled away! Taskin bangs this one short and on middle, it sits up nicely for the pull. Latham nails it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Uppish but just short. The Kiwis are riding their luck here. Full and outside off, Latham looks to drive. The ball takes the toe end and goes uppishly towards the cover fielder. Mithun there dives forward and looks to catch but it falls just short. Two taken.
Full and wide outside off, Neesham looks to drive but ends up getting it off the inner half. A single taken.
On the pads, James looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. They appeal for LBW but it is turned down.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! Oh, dear, Rahim! What have you done? That was an easy chance but Rahim spills it. A good length ball just outside off, it shapes away. Neesham looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and it goes behind. The keeper, Rahim, dives to his left and tries to catch. The ball goes in and pops out. This can be a huge miss in the game.
A single now as this is hit down to long off.
Shorter and outside off, Neesham pushes it through covers for two.
Tossed up on off, Neesham defends it.
Quicker and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.

Shorter and outside off, Latham cuts it through covers for one. Fifty for Latham! The skipper leading from the front for the Kiwis too. He though will hold the key for them. Needs to stay there till the end.
On middle, defended.
A single as this is pushed to mid off.
On middle, it is defended.
James Neesham is in now.

DRINKS! An excellent partnership between these two kept the Kiwis in this run chase nicely. However, the excellent piece of effort from the skipper who himself got run out means that the visitors are back in the game. Another wicket here and they will be right on top. Tom Latham will have to stay till the end now, if the hosts are to seal the deal. This is surely going down the wire now.

OUT! CONWAY IS SHORT! Just what Bangladesh needed and it is their skipper who has provided them the wicket. Did it with the bat earlier on and now in the field! This is tossed up on off, Conway pushes it towards mid off and takes off. Tamim gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. He hits. Bangladesh are celebrating, it is taken upstairs and replays show that Conway is out. Big, big breakthrough as this stand was taking the game away from Bangladesh. New Zealand still on top but Bangladesh will feel they now have a chance to put the Kiwis under pressure. 106 more needed.
Is that a wicket? Direct hits are always close and it is skipper Tamim who has hit the bull's eyes. Bangaldesh are looking confident here. Here comes the replay. Yes. GONE! Huge moment in the game.
BEATEN! Length and around off, it shapes away. Conway looks to defend but is beaten.
Good length and on off, Conway guides it to point.
On off, this is pushed to the man at cover.
WIDE! Down the leg side, it has been wided.
On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
The sweep is out again, it is played towards deep square leg for one.
On middle, blocked.
FOUR! Msifled and a boundary! The sweep is out. It is hit hard towards deep square leg. Mahmudullah in the deep runs to his left but he slides over the ball.
Another single as Latham nudges it around the corner for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another single as this is dropped towards the cover region.
Two! Length and on off, Conway pushes it on the up through mid off for a couple.
One more single! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is guided through point.
FOUR! Lovely! Yes, it is a half volley but still needs to be put away. This is full and outside off, Conway creams it through covers for a boundary.
Slower one on middle, Conway works it to mid-wicket.
Another one on the stumps, it is pushed back to the bowler.
On off, blocked.
Latham comes down the track, he clips it nicely over mid-wicket for two.
On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for one.
Flatter and on middle, blocked.
On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
That is very short and down the leg side. Latham misses as he looks to pull it hard but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a run is taken.
Mohammad Mithun is on now.
Two again! Outside off, Conway once again opens the face of the bat and plays it fine on the off side. Two. A good over for the Kiwis! 128 needed in the last 20.
Latham now guides it down to third man. A little too close to the man so just the one.
Excellent fielding! Shorter and outsode off, Conway plays it late and fine on the off side. Saifuddin runs to his right, dives and pushes it back in. Saves a run for his side. Excellent commitment.
Angled into the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for two.
That is a beauty from Rahman! The cutter. It lands outside off and then jags back in. Conway is cut into half. The extra bounce saves him as it goes over the stumps.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Latham now takes another single as this is worked through square leg.

Fifty for Conway! His maiden in ODIs! A knock under a lot of pressure. Superb from him. A very easy on the eye innings so far from him. He though would know the job is not done yet. He gets there by stroking this on the up through covers for one.
Good length and on off, Conway pushes it to covers.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Good fielding! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on where the fielder slides and keeps it to one.
An optimistic appeal but turned down! On the pads, Latham looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Full ball on middle, Latham flicks it to deep square leg. He takes the first one quickly and wants second but is sent back.
WIDE! Banged short and outside off, Latham lets it be. Wided.
Full and outside off, Latham drives it to deep cover and takes two. Excellent running between the wickets.
Fuller and around middle, flicked behind square on the leg side for an easy single.
Short again, it is crunched through the covers for a single.
Excellent stop! Shortish and outside off, Conway cuts it but the point fielder dives to his right to make a half stop.
Angled in from around off. It is on a fullish length. Latham flicks it off the inside edge down to fine leg for one.
Mustafizur Rahman returns now.
Full and wide outside off, driven down to deep cover for one more run. Just 4 off the over. 148 needed in 138 balls.
Shortish and around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Shortish and outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
Fuller and on middle, it is flicked wide of the man at deep mid-wicket. Easy two. The stand moves to 69.
Full and around off, pushed through mid off for an easy run.
Just past the off pole! Lovely yorker ball just outside off, Conway looks to keep it out but misses.
In the air... safe again. Tossed up and on middle, Conway goes for the sweep. Hits it uppishly but it goes uppishly towards deep square leg for a run.
On middle, tucked on the leg side for an easy run.
On middle, clipped through square leg for one.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs here. Mahedi loses his line now and bowls this one down the leg side. Conway looks to flick but misses. Rahim cannot do much about it as it races away to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Conway brings out the reverse sweep and nails it over short third man for a boundary. Lovely shot and he enters into the 40s now.

In the air... safe! Tossed up and on middle, Latham comes down the track and looks to hammer it over the leg side. He mistimes it as he fails to get to the pitch of the ball. The ball goes high in the sky but lands behind the bowler. A single taken.
Floated around off, played back to the bowler.
Mahedi Hasan is on now.
Around off on a length, pushed to mid on for nothing.
Dot! Length and around middle, pushed to mid on.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly through the covers for one.
Banged short and on middle, Conway pulls. The mid-wicket fielder makes a half stop. A single taken.
Around off on a good length, blocked.
WIDE! Slipped down the leg side. Conway looks to flick but misses. Wided bu the umpire.
Good length and around middle, tucked towards mid on for a quick run.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on. Just the one over before this. Can he break this stand?
A maiden from Mehidy. The last ball is tossed u and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Darted just outside off on a slightly shortish length. Blocked.
Flat and around middle, Conway blocks it towards the mid-wicket region. Tidy from Mehidy so far.
On middle, kept out. Three dots in a row now.
Short again and spinning away. Pushed towards point this time.
Shortish and around off and middle, pushed towards mid on for nothing.
Another short ball. This one is a well-directed one. Latham looks to pull but he is a bit early. It goes off the toe end towards the off side.
WIDE! Tasking bangs this one short but down the leg side. Tom looks to pull but misses. Wided. The extra brings up 50-run stand between the two.
Shortish and outside off, punched to deep cover for a run.
Length and around off, played back to the bowler.
Fullish and just around off, punched to the left side of the man at mid off for a quick run.
Banged short and middle, Conway pulls it through square leg for a run. 100 up for the Kiwis. 172 more needed.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Dot to end the over! Flat and just outside off, punched towards mid off for nothing.
On middle, tucked towards short fine leg for a quick run.
Tossed up and outside off, Latham comes down the track and pokes it through mid on for one.
Darted around off, it skids through. Latham does well to get his bat down to block.
Floated full and around middle, it is eased down to long on for a run.
Flat and around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for two.
A dot to end! On off, Latham guides it to point.
WIDE! A little too short this time. Wided. First extra of the innings.
A bumper, it is ducked under.
One more single! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Uppish but in the gap! Outside off, Latham looks to hit it on the up but it goes off the outer half wide of point for one.
Two is the call again and two is what they get again. On the pads, this is worked through square leg for another two.
Taskin Ahmed is back on. 4-0-21-0 from him so far.
Two is the call and two is what they get! Fuller and around off, this is driven through covers for a couple.
Quick run now! Latham comes down the track and drops it towards cover for a run.
FOUR! Sheer timing! Exquisite! Welcome boundary! On middle, a little too full. It is driven down the ground crisply. The long on fielder runs to his right but has no chance.
Floats it up on off, Latham pushes it to covers.
Just another single! Tossed up nicely on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, it is guided to point.
Floats it up on off, Conway pushes it to mid off.
On off, quicker. Defended.
Sweeps it nicely down to deep backward square leg for one.
Another dot! Outside off, it is cut to point.
On middle, Latham punches it down to long on for one.
Shorter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Flatter and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! A fine phase for Bangladesh. Their spinners have put the Kiwi batters in the middle under pressure. They are now allowing easy runs to them and the asking rate has been creeping up. Conway has looked good though and will hope to put on a big stand along with the skipper. Mahedi Hasan has struck twice and would aim to break this stand as quickly as they can. Exciting chase coming brewing up now.
Loopy ball on off, defended.
Floats it up on middle, Latham works it towards mid-wicket for one more.
Another single as Conway plays it down to long on.
On middle, it is pushed down to long on for one.

Bowler, bowler was the call from Rahim but Taskin picked the wrong end! This is tossed up on off, Conway looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg. Latham wants a run and Conway is late in taking off. Tasking gets to the ball quickly and fires it towards the keeper's end but misses the stumps.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Latham comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Tossed up nicely once again, Conway guides it to point.
Well bowled! The arm ball, it comes in from outside off. Conway defends it late.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked towards square leg for one.
On off, it is pushed to covers.
A single now as this is pushed towards cover. Good batting.
FOUR! Smashed away! Shorter in length and on middle, Latham rocks back and hammers the pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
EDGY RUNS! Latham goes back to a delivery he should be playing forward to. It is on off and spins away. Latham looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge down towards third man for two.
On off, Conway pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on off, Latham pushes it through covers for one.
Two! Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, this is pushed towards cover for one more.
Tossed up nicely on off, Latham pushes at it. It goes off the outer half through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover.
Dot to end the over. Quicker one from Mehidy. It is short and it turns away with extra bounce. Conways blocks off the outer half.
Flat and around off, hit down to long on for one.
Flat and around off, Tom blocks solidly.
Tossed up and around off, kept out.
Flat and around middle, Latham tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, turning away. Punched down to deep cover for one.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Chance! On off, this is guided towrads point. The batters go for a run. The fielder runs in and looks to pick the ball up but fails to do so.
Latham comes down the track but the length is shortened. He looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Another single as this is pushed down to long off.
Floats it up on off, Conway blocks it.
Loopy ball on off, Latham pushes it down to long off for one.
Lands on off, holds its line. Conway adjusts and guides it to point.
Flighted ball on off, Conway is solid in defense.
On middle, Conway blocks it.
Latham comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He pushes it towards cover for one.
Tossed up outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed to covers.
More spin! Here's Mehidy Hasan with the ball now. Slip in place.
On the pads, Latham looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. End of another successful over for Hasan.
Skipper Tom Latham is in now.

OUT! TIMBER! Mahedi has another one and Will Young does not make much of an impression. Bangladesh on top now. The fine leg was moved back, Will Young looks to paddle thinking it is an easy single but he moves way too across. The ball lands on off and then turns back in. It misses the bat and hits the stumps.
Flatter and on middle, this is defended.
On middle, it is nudged to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Conway looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Powerplay 2 time! Maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle.
So two boundaries and 4 dots from the over! On middle, kept out.
Back to bowling it on a length, it is pushed to mid off.

FOUR! Thumped! Once again a little too short and it sits up to be hit. Conway hammers it through mid-wicket this time. The fielder in the deep did not have a lot to move but it has gone past him like a rocket.
Back of a length and on off, Conway pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Too short and put away! Short at this pace is not going to trouble Conway. He rocks back and pulls it all along the ground through backward square leg for a boundary.
Outside off and angling away. Left alone.
Change from the other end too as Saifuddin comes on!
Some turn! This lands outside off, it is shorter. Spins back in. Hits Young high on the pads as he tries to flick. A wicket maiden then for Hasan.
On the pads, Young works it to short fine leg.
Flatter and on middle, Young pushes it to the right of the bowler. No runs.
Will Young walks out to bat!

OUT! TIMBER! The ploy to move to spin has worked wonders as Hasan has got the better of Nicholls. Not sure what Henry played there. This is fired into the leg pole. Nicholls looks to go over long on. He has a wild hack. Misses and it hits the stumps. New Zealand in a spot of bother here. 229 more needed.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Mahedi Hasan is on now! Time for some spin!
FOUR! Awkwardly played but gets the desired result! Shorter and on middle, it seems to have hurried Conway but he still manages to pull it through square leg for a boundary.
Half stop! Shorter and outside off, Nicholls slaps it towards point. The fielder there dives to his left, makes a half stop. Single taken.
Fuller and on off, Conway strokes it to mid off. One taken.
Fuller and on middle, Conway strokes it to mid on.
On off, Conway defends it solidly.

Edgy! Length and angling away from off. Nicholls hangs his bat out. It goes off the outside edge down to third man for one. No second slip. Had there been one, Bangladesh could have had another wicket.
On off, Conway pushes it to mid off.
Shortish and outside off, Nicholls slashes at it. It goes off the outside edge down towards third man for one.
Angled into the middle pole, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length and on middle, Conway defends it onto the ground.
Good length and on off, blocked.
FOUR! What a shot to get off the mark! That should give him a lot of confidence! Length and on off, Conway hits it on the up wide of mid off and into the fence.
One more length delivery, it is angling away from the off pole. Nicholls shoulders arms to this one.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Nicholls slashes at it but misses.
Back of a length and on middle, Nicholls works it to mid-wicket.
One more delivery outside off, Nicholls shoulders arms to this one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Henry stands tall and pushes it through covers. Two taken.
Outside off, Nicholls lets it be.
Devon Conway walks out to bat!

OUT! Caught and bowled! Rahman has the big fish, the in-form Guptill and Bangladesh have a wicket relatively early. Not the best of deliveries. It is down the leg side. Probably gripped in the surface. Guptill closes the face of the bat early. He gets a leading edge which lobs behind the bowler. Rahman runs back and takes it.
FOUR! Save your head Nicholls! What a shot! Not a bad delivery this. Length and on off, Guptill smashes it back towards the non-striker who ducks in time and it goes to the fence.
Outside off, Guptill guides it to point.
Just pushes it back in! Saves a run for his side! On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket. Three taken.
FOUR! Bread and butter stuff for Nicholls! It is short and wide outside off, Nicholls hops and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good length and on off, defended.
Dot to end the over. Good length and outside off, punched towards the cover-point fielder.

Confusion again. Safe again. A good length ball outside off, Guptill punches it to the left side of the cover fielder. The fielder at covers dives to his left and makes a half stop. Guptill thinks for the single as the ball goes away. Nicholls sends him back. The fielder from cover-point has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Excellent comeback from Taskin. Lands this just outside off and makes it to move away. Guptill looks to defend but misses.

SIX! Slapped! Shortish and outside off, Guptill rocks on his back foot and crunches it over deep backward point for a biggie. Didn't connect it all too well but it is good enough to sail over the fence.
Full and on middle again, Guptill finds mid on.
Full and on middle, Nicholls flicks it wide of the man at mid on and takes one for a run to open his account.
FOUR! Creamed! Little too full and outside off as well. Guptill leans into the shot and strokes it through the covers for a boundary. Good end to the over for the Kiwis.
Make that 5. Around off on a length. Guptill gets on the front foot and defends.
Good length and outside off, Guptill blocks. 4 dots now.
Three dots in a row! A good length ball around off, Martin blocks and a loud no for the single follows.
Shortish and just around off, punched towards the covers.
Good length and around off, pushed towards the point region.
Beaten! Lovely ball to end the over. Shortish and just around middle, Nicholls pokes at it but the ball moves away to beat the outside edge.

Mix up but safe! Length ball on the pads, Guptill looks to flick but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. Guptill takes off for the single. Nicholls responds as well but Guptill stops for a moment. Nicholls stops as well but Guptill once again goes for the run. Nicholls does that too and races across. The fielder at short fine leg has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. Wouldn't have mattered as he was home.
Shortish and outside off, punched straight to the man at extra cover.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Good length and around off, played towards the cover region.
FOUR! Crunched! Poor ball first up and Guptill is not going to miss out. Short and wide outside off, Guptill gets on his toes and hammers it through the covers. Races away to the fence.
Taskin Ahmed to partner Mustafizur Rahman from the other end.
Good end the over. Good length and around off, Nicholls pushes it back to the bowler. Tidy over from Mustafizur first up. Just a run off it.
Edgy! Guptill and New Zealand are underway though. A length ball outside off, Guptill looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man for one.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid off this time. Good start from Rahman so far.
Shortish and around off, Guptill rides the bounce and blocks.
Good length and around middle, Guptill looks to work it on the leg side but the ball moves away a touch. Martin adjusts well to push it towards the off side.
Mustafizur is right on the money. A length ball just outside off, Guptill pushes it towards point.
